test_AIAgent_steer_acceptance: test the AIAgent.steer() method accepts non-empty text, rejects empty/whitespace/None inputs, strips surrounding whitespace, and concatenates multiple steer calls with newlines
test_AIAgent_steer_drain: test the AIAgent._drain_pending_steer() method returns the pending steer text and clears it, and returns None when empty
test_AIAgent_steer_injection: test the AIAgent._apply_pending_steer_to_tool_results() method appends steer text as a USER STEER marker to the last tool result, handles multimodal content lists, and re-stashes when no tool messages exist
test_AIAgent_steer_thread_safety: test concurrent steer() calls preserve all injected text using the internal threading lock without dropping any messages
test_AIAgent_steer_interrupt_clear: test the AIAgent.clear_interrupt() method drops any pending steer when an interrupt is requested
